nodes.label: Rhode Island uses graduated licensing for drivers younger than eighteen, progressing from an instructional permit to a provisional license and then full operator privileges.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: No single interchangeable alternative is asserted for this complete source condition; related requirements keep separate nodes and their exact qualifiers.

nodes.label: An applicant aged sixteen to eighteen needs to complete an accredited thirty-three-hour driver-education course and pass the computerized knowledge examination before receiving a limited learner permit.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: No single interchangeable alternative is asserted for this complete source condition; related requirements keep separate nodes and their exact qualifiers.

nodes.label: An applicant older than eighteen must take the knowledge examination but does not have to attend the classroom driver-education course.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: No single interchangeable alternative is asserted for this complete source condition; related requirements keep separate nodes and their exact qualifiers.

nodes.label: A limited learner permit cannot be issued before the applicant reaches sixteen years of age.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: No single interchangeable alternative is asserted for this complete source condition; related requirements keep separate nodes and their exact qualifiers.

nodes.label: Driver-education enrollment can begin before permit age if the student is at least fifteen years and ten months old when the course starts.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: No single interchangeable alternative is asserted for this complete source condition; related requirements keep separate nodes and their exact qualifiers.

nodes.label: Bring original proof of age and identity to the first driver-education class because photocopies are not accepted.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Knowledge-test preparation should focus on the handbook's motor vehicle laws and road rules.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A limited instructional permit is preliminary driving authority for a learner below eighteen who has passed the knowledge examination.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A limited learner permit application requires original acceptable identity documentation rather than photocopies.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A permit applicant younger than eighteen must provide proof of completing thirty-three hours of driver education.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The permit application requires two documents proving Rhode Island residency.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A learner permit application must be accompanied by the applicable permit fee.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Permit fees may be paid using cash, an accepted check, a credit card or a money order, but a third-party check is not accepted.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A qualifying parent, guardian, licensed foster parent or adult spouse generally accompanies a minor applying for a permit.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A legal guardian must bring court documentation, while a licensed foster parent needs the relevant child-services documentation.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A parent without a valid Rhode Island driver license may sign a minor's application but cannot act as the supervising driver.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A parent who does not qualify as a supervising driver must ride in the rear seat during driving practice.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The handbook's detailed supervisor rule requires a licensed driver aged at least twenty-one with at least five years of driving licensure.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: An applicant must complete vision screening or provide a vision examination card signed by an optometrist or ophthalmologist.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Applicants who use corrective lenses for distance vision must wear them for vision screening.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The handbook states a corrected visual-acuity requirement of twenty over forty.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A minor's permit or license application needs the required adult signature and verification.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: If no qualifying parent, guardian or licensed foster parent is available, another responsible adult may sign a minor's application by accepting the associated legal obligation.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: During learner practice, the qualifying supervisor must sit beside the learner and remain ready to take control in an emergency.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The supervising licensed driver carries legal responsibility for a learner's driving violations.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A learner must wear a safety belt unless a physician's letter supplied to the DMV documents a medical reason for not wearing one.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Every passenger accompanying a learner must use the safety belt or child restraint required by law.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Practice on different roads and in varied conditions helps a learner identify and correct unsafe habits.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A learner must hold the instructional permit for at least six months before taking the DMV driving-skills test.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The limited learner permit's validity paragraph says it lasts until the holder's eighteenth birthday and allows at most two renewals.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The limited-permit validity paragraph says a permit expired for more than two years cannot be renewed.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Someone who turns eighteen before holding a limited learner permit for a year may apply for a full learner permit.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Eligibility for a provisional license requires at least six months with a limited learner permit.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A provisional-license applicant must have avoided moving-violation and seat-belt convictions during the preceding six months.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The provisional-license applicant must pass the DMV driving-skills test.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A parent or guardian must sign a statement confirming at least fifty hours of supervised practice, including ten hours at night, for provisional licensing.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: An applicant who fails the driving-skills test must arrange another test rather than receiving a license from the failed attempt.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: First-time applicants must take the driving-skills test, while holders of a valid license from another state do not have to take it.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Use a familiar vehicle so that its controls can be located without looking for them while driving.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Before driving in rain, know how to operate the vehicle's headlights and windshield wipers.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Know the location of the vehicle's hazard-light control without needing someone else to point it out.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: After passing the driving-skills test, obtain the limited provisional license from the DMV before the learner permit expires.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: An applicant younger than eighteen needs the required accompanying adult when collecting a provisional license unless that adult's application signature has been notarized.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A responsible adult who accepts the legal obligation may substitute when no qualifying parent, guardian, licensed foster parent or adult spouse is available.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: After failing a driving-skills test, the applicant must wait at least thirty days before the next test appointment.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: If a second permit expiration occurs before another road-test appointment is available, the applicant may need a new permit and another knowledge examination.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A provisional license permits driving at any time when a qualifying supervising driver sits beside the license holder.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The general unsupervised driving window for a provisional license runs from five in the morning until one the following morning.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A provisional driver may travel without supervision outside the general driving window when going to or returning from work.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A provisional driver who belongs to a volunteer fire, rescue or emergency-medical organization may travel without supervision to or from that organization's activity.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Between four and five in the morning, a provisional driver may travel between home and a school-sponsored athletic activity when the school provides no transportation.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Every occupant must use the required safety belt or child restraint during provisional-license driving, with or without supervision.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The learner provisional license expires when the holder turns eighteen.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The detailed provisional-license rule allows at most one passenger younger than twenty-one during the first twelve months, with immediate family and household members exempt.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Full operator licensing requires a minimum age of seventeen years and six months.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A full operator applicant must have held the limited provisional license for at least twelve months.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A full operator license removes the graduated-license restrictions on driving times and supervision while leaving ordinary traffic and restraint laws in force.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A full operator applicant must have no moving-violation or seat-belt conviction during the preceding six months.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A driver whose license is suspended may retain the physical license for identification but cannot use it as authority to drive.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A suspension prohibits driving in Rhode Island and in other states throughout the suspension period.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Failure to pay a traffic fine, an offense requiring suspension or another state's suspension request can lead to a license suspension.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Recorded motor vehicle violations are public information that insurers can inspect, potentially increasing insurance rates.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The learner must carry the permit whenever driving under its authority.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Only the qualifying supervising driver may occupy the front seat with a limited learner permit holder.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A provisional driver must have the provisional license in their possession while driving.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The handbook's summary permits a full operator license holder to drive without graduated-license passenger limitations.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: An out-of-state license suspension must be resolved with that state before applying for a Rhode Island license.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: An applicant transferring a valid out-of-state license, or one expired no more than five years, is not required by the handbook to take the knowledge or driving-skills test.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A former Rhode Island license holder whose license expired no more than five years ago is also exempt from the handbook's knowledge and driving-skills tests.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Restrictions and endorsements on an out-of-state license transfer to equivalent Rhode Island restrictions or endorsements.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: An out-of-state transfer requires the first-license application, acceptable supporting documents, Rhode Island residency proof and surrender of the other state's license.
